source.paginationNote: The canonical PHB has 130 physical PDF pages and 128 numbered printed pages plus other/unprinted physical matter. This report makes no whole-book completeness claim.

scope.cohort: Class overview, all eleven PHB class guides, source tables, class-specific abilities/procedures, multiclass/dual-class rules and Bard Appendix II.
scope.overlapBoundary: At printed p.18, only the CHARACTER CLASSES overview prose is in scope; race preferences and ability/race eligibility rules belong to the separate pp.9–19 race/ability audit. The p.19 class tables remain in this cohort.
excludedSegments: The printed-p.23 full-page illustration on PDF24 contains no class rules.
Printed-p.32 left-column Monk content is in scope; right-column multiclass content is also in scope.
Printed-p.33 left-column multiclass/dual-class content is in scope; right-column alignment chapter is out of scope.
Printed-p.117 right-column Bard Appendix II is in scope; left-column Psionics is out of scope.

The Cleric turn-undead matrix, DMG p.74 attack matrices, the 206 class XP values, 10 Cavalier HP targets, and 11 XP-continuation tuples are not reaudited; only relevant prior evidence is cross-referenced.

method.sourceFirst: Enumerated class page tables, headings, row/axis structures, notes, ability families and procedures before comparing to site data. Text extraction was used only to locate table heads/continuations; every in-scope page was then inspected as an actual full-page 2x rendered image. One source page per visual inspection result, with its visible folio verified.
method.siteJoin: Joined to exact owners in pinned full-site snapshot; inspected sourceRecord field inventory, captured direct-route DOM text and captured public search text. Title self-match is evidenced; exact mechanic-query execution is not claimed.
method.reviewSemantics: reviewClosed means the finite named table/procedure/ability families in this cohort were inventoried and given a surface disposition. siteContentComplete is separate. The source clause denominator for all narrative prose remains unknown; this does not claim every sentence in the PHB was split into an atomic rule.

unitReviews.label: Class overview, Table I/II and multi-class hit-point procedure

sourceAssertions.sourceAssertion: PHB introduces the standard classes and says later descriptions explain abilities/functions/levels; class selection is constrained by generated abilities and race, and notes a general multi-class restriction.
sourceAssertions.concreteLimit: Eleven PHB class guides and progression metadata exist, but there is no source-mapped overview owner joining this p.18 class-selection prose.

sourceAssertions.sourceAssertion: Class, hit-die type, maximum hit dice, spell ability, and class-level limit; notes specify starting/max die and spell-scroll thresholds.
sourceAssertions.concreteLimit: Class guides expose each hitDie and selected caps/level limits; no full 10×5 source matrix or all four starred qualifications is rendered as one PHB table.

sourceAssertions.sourceAssertion: Roll each class die; total and apply Constitution; divide by number of classes, dropping sub-half fractions and rounding half-or-more upward; quotient is HP gained for the level.
sourceAssertions.concreteLimit: The PHB class-guide routes cite the page, but current multiclass rule card focuses on XP division and equipment; this four-step HP calculation is not represented.

sourceAssertions.sourceAssertion: Class permissions for armor, shields, weapons, oil and poison, with magical weapon, alignment, height/weight, thief sword and referee-poison qualifications.
sourceAssertions.concreteLimit: Some equipment and thief-function restrictions are summarized in separate cards; the complete 10×6 permission grid and all notes are not present on class guides.
